item.lolo_seasons.spark_shard.desc: A grain of the power living in every worldwalker.
item.lolo_seasons.time_fragment.desc: A frozen second from a world where time has ended.
item.lolo_seasons.archey_ingot.desc: Metal of a half-dead world. Holds echoes of memories.
item.lolo_seasons.thirteen_fires_ember.d: The heat of the Egyptian sands never fades.
item.lolo_seasons.spark_staff.desc: Right-click: short blink in the direction you look.
item.lolo_seasons.time_clock: Clock of the End of Time
item.lolo_seasons.time_clock.desc: Right-click: skips to the next morning and clears the weather.
item.lolo_seasons.scarab_amulet.desc: Right-click: night vision, speed and fire resistance for 90 seconds. Worn in a Curios charm slot: permanent night vision and fire resistance.
dialog.lolo_seasons.wanderer.0: The Spark inside you burns brighter than you think, worldwalker.
dialog.lolo_seasons.wanderer.1: They say time stopped in Archey... I wouldn't test that alone.
dialog.lolo_seasons.wanderer.2: Bring me four Spark shards and I will trade you two Time Fragments.
dialog.lolo_seasons.wanderer.3: Worlds are endless, yet the road is always one: forward.
dialog.lolo_seasons.wanderer.4: Careful with clocks. Time does not like being toyed with.
dialog.lolo_seasons.wanderer.trade: A fair deal, worldwalker. Here are your Time Fragments.
dialog.lolo_seasons.automaton.0: Greetings. All city systems are operating normally.
dialog.lolo_seasons.automaton.1: I am an ordinary resident. Completely ordinary. Beep.
dialog.lolo_seasons.automaton.2: Seasonal weather change complete. A warm jacket is recommended.
dialog.lolo_seasons.automaton.3: Faint Spark detected. This does not concern me. Yet.
dialog.lolo_seasons.automaton.4: The university is at the end of the street. Tardiness is discouraged.
dialog.lolo_seasons.automaton.phone: Your smartphone is synced with the city network. This is perfectly safe.
lolo_seasons.configuration.title: Lololoshka Seasons Configs
